fields: (a grid block, as: "route"): h, nav, items [{t, d, spot, part, code, link}]. part: an IsoKit part kind to draw; without it the spot picks one (binder, toc -> analyzer, ro-skid -> ro, storage-tank -> tank, heat-exchanger -> hx, cpu -> panel, pump, uv), else the spot's line icon. code (optional): a short mono area code, a drawing label (aria-hidden). A link makes the row's name a link (it still selects on focus).
best_for: ReviewReticles sets what an assessment reviews as a drawing register on a limestone sheet, with one inspection viewfinder that shows the pointed area's thing in IsoKit line art.
